The balance sheet shows moderate overall leverage, with liabilities at roughly 48% of assets and substantial book equity, but liquidity is very tight with current assets only matching current liabilities. The very large accumulated deficit and relatively modest EBIT/revenue base versus the size of the balance sheet suggest limited operating cushion, so the credit profile looks more like the low end of investment grade / high end of speculative grade; on balance I would place it at **BB+**.

DECISION: BB+
